scope: New local gallbladder/liver/cavity engineering scene, contact grasping and state provenance; no suturing or clinical calibration

required.preservation: Exact membership, byte size and SHA-256 for every Phase1-4 delivery, Phase4 collision repair and original source reference
required.editable_assets: Blender source scene, reproducible generator, independent original modeling provenance, SI units and geometry audit
required.mesh: Finite coordinates, nondegenerate faces/tets, positive physical tetrahedron volumes, closed single-component liver and gallbladder boundary surfaces
required.hepatic_bed: 31 fixed spring endpoints reconstruct from actual hepatic triangle barycentrics within 1e-8m; declared apposed outer-wall gap; no recorded wall/liver triangle intersection or vertex containment on tested paths
required.interaction: Both tools use actual unilateral friction contact, meaningful deformation, attachment retention, release and reset

collision.definition: Physical node and whole-face penetration checked from recorded jaw geometry; declared finite paths, not CCD proof

repeatability.events: identical; immutable model, material and configuration identities required

required.packaged_input: Actual PlayerController input sequence and accepted native state; no direct tissue position injection
required.delivery: Fresh ZIP extraction, launch and exact tested binary/source/asset hashes

performance_target.notes: Report achieved FPS, physics step timing, actual simulation progression and test workload independently; do not present slow simulation as realtime

external_review: Tutor/clinician review of anatomy and experimental tissue-parameter validation remain separately labeled; engineering tests cannot supply those approvals
